dedupe_keys.name: noise data reported under the eu environmental noise directive end exposure contours and quiet areas

description: The European Environment Agency compiles noise data reported by countries under the Environmental Noise Directive (2002/49/EC). The datahub item groups four products: noise exposure data, vector noise contours, rasterised noise contours and potential quiet areas. Coverage: EEA32 member countries and the United Kingdom (Turkey excluded for the 2017 round); sources are major roads, major railways, major airports and urban agglomerations. Exposure tables count people in 5 dB bands for Lden (55 to over 75) and Lnight (50 to over 70), inside and outside urban areas, with percentages; some countries add lower bands voluntarily. Reporting runs in five-year rounds, with exposure submitted in 2007, 2012, 2017 and 2022. Format and access: Excel exposure tables (2022 data, November 2024 release) and 2022 contours as GeoPackage, file geodatabase, REST and WMS (March 2026). Licence and cost: free download; the licence is not given in the text read. Caveats: completeness depends on country submissions up to April 2024; methods differ between rounds. The data support exposure assessment of transport corridors and noise-aware network planning. It relates to the US national transportation noise map and England's strategic noise mapping in the catalogue.
